blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – As an anti-corruption strategy, Bangsamoro Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua vowed on Sunday to personally monitor the financial standing and payment obligations of the ministries and offices under the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). His pronouncement followed the signing of Memorandum of Agreement between the Bangsamoro Government and the Land Bank
